text:
sara: heads-up — planning a small autoscaling policy tweak to the dedicated-gpu pool tonight 21:00 PDT. goal is to lower baseline cost for low-util tiers without impacting latency. no model changes, only policy.

dan: +1. I'll own the deployment and smoke checks. estimate ~30m for canary + validation. tagging @jen for perf metrics, @leo for rollback path.

jen: copy. I'll prepare the dashboards and alerts. main checks: p50/p95/p99 gen latency, queue depth, OOMs, and any increase in 5xx. Will attach runbook.

leo: rollback plan: reapply previous autoscaler config via infra repo. command: `kubectl apply -f infra/dedicated/autoscale-prev.yaml --namespace=redwood-dedicated`

sara: config diff we'll roll: (snippet)
```
autoscaling:
  min_replicas: 2    # was 3
  max_replicas: 12   # unchanged
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.72  # was 0.78
  cooldown_sec: 90
```
this is intentionally conservative — reduces baseline by 1 replica for very low traffic windows.

dan: canary plan: 1) push config to 1 slice (slice-a) 2) wait 10m 3) run smoke suite 4) expand to slice-b if green. no global flip without explicit thumbs.

jen: smoke commands (quick):
```
# health
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.local/v1/health?pool=dedicated-gpu"
# quick gen
python infra/tests/smoke_inference.py --model gpt-medium --q 50 --workers 5
```
I will kick off automated runs once the canary is live.

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy: dedicated-gpu-autoscaler-update by dan at 2026-03-17T21:00:00-07:00. Canary target: slice-a. Reminder: If any alert fires during canary, deployment will pause.

sara: monitoring thresholds to abort/rollback: p99 latency increase >100ms above baseline OR error rate >0.5% OR queue depth >2x. If triggered, @dan will revert and we run postmortem.

dan: I have an infra window from 21:00-22:00. no other infra deploys planned that slot as far as I know. handing off to me at 20:45 for final checks. :rocket:

leo: quick checklist for deploy owner (dan):
- confirm slice-a labels and capacity
- run smoke health curl
- verify autoscaler pod logs for scale decisions
- ensure rollback config accessible in repo

sara: thanks. I'll be on-call for the first 45m of the canary. jen will own metrics. ping here when canary is applied and after smoke.

dan: will post status updates here. starting to stage config now. :eyes:

jen: attaching quick dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/g/dedicated/autoscale-smoke

sara: great — go ahead. keeping the change small so we can iterate quickly. :thumbsup:
